rationale: The signal establishes sufficiency and 1-minimality under the frozen replay. It does not establish that a and b are the unique underlying root cause in production; the mapping explicitly excludes inference of unique internal causes.

signal_basis.exact_text: Subset {a,b} produces F on every replay. Subsets {a} and {b} do not produce F on any replay.
No claim about globally smallest cardinality, other workloads or unique internal causes follows from single-removal minimality.
